# Plugins

15 first-party plugins for astral, each in its own folder here.

<!-- Generated from each manifest.toml by `astral readme`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/chat-dots-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Chat Bubbles](chat-bubbles/): Draws a rounded bubble behind each message, sized to its content.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/link-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Clear URLs](clear-urls/): Removes common tracking parameters from links before messages are sent or edited.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/eye-slash-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Enhanced Blocking](enhanced-blocking/): Filters incoming messages by user, keyword or reply author before Phoenix handles them.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/arrow-angle-left-up-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Highlight Replies](highlight-replies/): Tints the text of messages that reply to your messages.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/text-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Live Markdown](live-markdown/): Styles Discord markdown as you type in the message composer.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/user-circle-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Mention Avatars](mention-avatars/): Shows user avatars and role icons inside mentions.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/bell-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Mention Haptics](mention-haptics/): Taps your phone when a new message mentions you or arrives in a direct message.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/more-user-tags.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [More User Tags](more-user-tags/): Adds tags for webhooks and moderative roles, and can show each member's top coloured role.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/reaction-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Reaction Avatars](reaction-avatars/): Shows the people who reacted beside each message reaction.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/paint-palette-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Role Color Everywhere](role-color-everywhere/): Colors mentions, message text, role headers and names beside avatars with members' role colors.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/paint-palette-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Settings Theme](settings-theme/): Shows your theme behind User Settings and every page in it, which Discord leaves plain.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/show-me-your-name.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Show Me Your Name](show-me-your-name/): Display usernames next to display names, or show usernames only.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/text-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Text Replace](text-replace/): Rewrites outgoing message text with literal or Lua pattern rules.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/language-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Translate](translate/): Translates a message in place from its long-press menu with Unbound Translate, Google or MyMemory; tap again for the original.
- <img src="../../assets/readme-icons/user-circle-icon.svg" width="20" height="20" align="absmiddle" alt=""> [Typing Avatars](typing-avatars/): Shows the avatar of each person typing in front of their name.
